scripts.check:web: npm run check:ui && node --check src/original-bridge.js && npm run build:web && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/web',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/tauri-cli.mjs build --bundles dmg --target aarch64-apple-darwin && node scripts/publish-mac.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:web && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/web',{recursive:true,force:true})"
